what: Light leaks from the edge of the black disc in the center of the panel (three.js shader) — the ring light is a beam split by angular noise (cubed to sharpen) layered with a haze that fades outward from the circle with an exponent of 7, and the edge is ragged by the noise amount. The beams shift very slowly over time (.05 per second). Setting open from 0→1 makes the disc transparent and the light go out, creating a scene of entering beyond it.

options.radius: Disc radius (ratio of the panel’s short side), default .4
options.open: 0~1 — at 1 the disc and light are fully cleared (the consumer binds it to scroll), default 0

from.where: index.html Hero eclipse portal · about.html ground light hole (gl.js MR.portal — original three r182 Hero disc, measured on screen and rewritten as a new shader of the same shape)

note: Launching one WebGL per board is heavy, so use only one per page. Drawing stops when the board is off screen. Colors are --kf-ink (light) · --kf-bg (disc)
